title: Hurricane local statement (NWS)
description: An NWS hurricane local statement: local watches and warnings, situation, impacts and actions for one office's area. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

examples: Hurricane Marlena Local Statement Advisory Number 12
National Weather Service Lake Charles LA AL042026

sections.description: Sections with a heading and text

heading.description: Section heading as in the product (SYNOPSIS, NEAR TERM...)

examples: A Hurricane Warning and a Storm Surge Warning have been issued for the coast of Haldane Parish.

examples.heading: NEW INFORMATION
examples.text: A Hurricane Warning and a Storm Surge Warning have been issued for the coast of Haldane Parish.

examples.heading: WATCHES AND WARNINGS
examples.text: A Hurricane Warning and a Storm Surge Warning are in effect for Haldane Parish. Tropical storm conditions are expected to begin early Thursday.

examples.heading: SITUATION OVERVIEW
examples.text: Hurricane Marlena is moving north at 10 mph and is forecast to make landfall late Thursday.

examples.heading: POTENTIAL IMPACTS
examples.text: WIND: Extensive damage to roofs and trees. SURGE: Life-threatening inundation of 6 to 9 feet above ground. FLOODING RAIN: 8 to 12 inches. TORNADOES: A few possible.

examples.heading: PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS
examples.text: Complete evacuations in surge zones A and B by sunset Wednesday. Follow instructions from local officials.

examples.heading: NEXT UPDATE
examples.text: The next local statement will be issued by 1000 PM CDT.
